title: Pandian Stores 2
description: Sakthivel denies Palanivel his property share, claiming they have no relation. Gomathi warns him against the injustice as Pandian and the family stand united for Palanivel.

title: Ayyanar Thunai
description: Nila worries about Chandayatha's comfort at home, while Chozhan encourages her to enjoy the wedding. Later, Vannathi demands an apology from Pandian over their dispute.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
episodeTitle: Vijaya Tightens Her Watch on Manoj
description: Manoj's delay in proceeding with Vijaya's marriage proposal makes the family suspicious. Vijaya asks Meena and Shruthi to secretly monitor him and Rohini.

title: Neeya Naana
description: The debate explores cultural differences faced by other-state daughters-in-law in Tamil families. Mothers-in-law and daughters-in-law share stories of acceptance and bond.

title: Super Singer Junior
description: Love and gratitude take centre stage in the dedication round. Contestants pour their emotions into heartfelt performances while competing for Golden Voice of the Week.

title: Cooku With Comali
description: Teams take on Northeast and Sri Lankan dishes while tackling Comali challenges. Guest stars add to the fun as Chef Koushik awards the Golden Apron to the week's top performer.

title: Bigg Boss The Common Man
episodeTitle: The Common Man: The Bigg Boss Dream Begins
description: Maya welcomes the final 50 contestants as Raju, Aari and Oviya take the judge's seat. A race for limited seats puts the contestants through a tense test.
